name: sonzai-claude-skill
description: Three skills for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) building on the Sonzai SDK: (1) sonzai-sdk wizard for human-in-the-loop builds, (2) full-auto for autonomous closed-loop builds from a meeting transcript with API + UI verification, (3) sonzai-internal-staff gated extension for Sonzai staff dogfooding. Covers 7 archetypes across Python, TypeScript, and Go. Wizard now prescribes runtime mode (full-chat vs memory-layer via sessions vs memory-layer via /process) and BYOK as the production posture.
